description: Shared expectations (ADR 0018 §5) for the ADR 0026 §1 error object: each case opens an input with options (and, with `call: "pageCount"`, then reads the page count), and the Rust façade (crates/lamina/tests/error_contract.rs) and @lamina/pdf (packages/pdf/test/codes.test.ts) must both throw exactly `expected`, which validates against lamina.error/1. `file` is relative to the repository root; `text` is the input's bytes as UTF-8. Limits use the TS (camelCase) names.

expected.hint: ask for the password again and retry with the correct one

expected.message: max_nesting_depth exceeded at byte 89 of object 9's stream data
expected.hint: the input exceeds a safety limit; raise max_nesting_depth in Limits only if you trust the input

expected.hint: check that the bytes passed to open are a PDF file
